title: console-tooling-standup-notes-2026-03-04
content:
Console & Tooling — Standup notes + weekly update (Week of 2026-03-02)

Owner: Sofia Martinez (eng manager)
Context: Weekly standup and ad-hoc syncs for Console (UI/UX), Rollouts (canary/A/B), and Analytics (dashboard/telemetry). This doc captures daily standup blurbs, blockers, decisions, and action items.

=== Friday sync summary (2026-03-04) ===
Attendees: Sofia, Alex, Priya, Ethan, Claire, Nikhil, Becca
Duration: 30m

1) Quick wins / announcements
- Canary rollout of traffic-splitting feature (ROLLOUTS-201) passed smoke tests on staging. Visible metrics being collected in ANALYTICS-78. (Priya)
- UI accessibility sweep: found contrast issues on settings modal; minor rollback PR opened (see PR #456). (Alex / Becca)
- Console dashboard latency alert on Wed evening traced to query N+1 in usage-aggregator. Patch in review. (Ethan / Nikhil)

2) Standup updates (Yesterday / Today / Blockers)
- Alex Kim (UI)
  - Yesterday: QA feedback addressed for settings modal; opened fix PR (GH #456). Started on new modal animation perf tweaks.
  - Today: Merge and ship rollback if QA green; pair with Becca for accessibility labels.
  - Blockers: Need final accessibility copy from PM (Connie).

- Priya Patel (Rollouts)
  - Yesterday: Deployed canary to 10% for customers on Dedicated; collecting telemetry.
  - Today: Increase to 25% if no regressions; run canary smoke tests against job-scheduler.
  - Blockers: Missing long-tail error rate baseline for a subset of customers (holding on analytics dashboard query).

- Ethan Wang (Analytics)
  - Yesterday: Investigated dashboard spike; root cause draft in ANALYTICS-78. Patch for aggregator query ready.
  - Today: Deploy patch to staging; validate historical dashboards and cost estimates.
  - Blockers: Need access to raw logs for a customer subset (security sign-off pending).

- Claire Robinson (QA)
  - Yesterday: End-to-end tests flaked on session replay; rerunning.
  - Today: Greenlight rollback PR, run full regression on staging after merge.
  - Blockers: flaky test CONSOLE-E2E-13 — triage scheduled.

- Nikhil Gupta (Backend / Integrations)
  - Yesterday: Investigated high-latency SQL path in usage-aggregator; prepared index suggestion and query rewrite.
  - Today: Deploy DB migration to staging during maintenance window; monitor.
  - Blockers: DB migration needs ops window approval (infra ticket).

- Becca Huang (Design / UX)
  - Yesterday: Reviewed accessibility issues; provided updated spec for modal and control labels.
  - Today: Work with Alex to finalize button focus states; prepare notes for PM demo.
  - Blockers: Waiting on final copy, see Alex note.

3) Decisions / Notes
- Canary: hold at 10% until analytics baseline query completes. Action: Priya to revert to 10% if metric variance > 2x (see ROLLOUTS-201).
- UI rollback: Approve rollback of the new settings modal visual change (PR #456) to unblock customers. Rationale: accessibility regressions and higher-than-expected layout shifts.
- Analytics query: prioritize patch for usage-aggregator to remove N+1; this reduces median dashboard latency by ~40% in staging.

4) Action items (owner / due)
- Priya: Keep canary at 10% and run extended smoke tests; update ROLLOUTS-201 by EOD 2026-03-04.
- Ethan: Deploy aggregator patch to staging and run regression dashboards; link to ANALYTICS-78 by 2026-03-04.
- Nikhil: File infra window request for DB migration and coordinate with SRE; target 2026-03-06.
- Alex + Becca: Merge accessibility rollback and reapply visual changes behind feature flag; complete by 2026-03-05.
- Claire: Triage CONSOLE-E2E-13 and disable flaky step if not resolved; update test plan by 2026-03-05.
- Sofia: Prep summary for PM + CS about canary status and user impact; send update by 2026-03-05 noon PT.

5) Risks / Blockers (high-level)
- Telemetry gap for specific enterprise customers prevents confident canary ramping. (security/log access required)
- Flaky end-to-end tests risk blocking merges to main; need short-term guardrails.
- DB migration scheduling pending ops window — could delay aggregator fix rollout.

6) Follow-ups / Meeting schedule
- Perf triage deep-dive: Tue 2026-03-09 11:00am PT (SRE, analytics, backend)
- Accessibility review: Mon 2026-03-08 9:30am PT (design, frontend, PM)
- Weekly console sync: Next Fri 2026-03-06 10:00am PT

7) Misc notes / references
- PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/456 (UI rollback), https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/461 (aggregator query fix)
- Jira: CONSOLE-512 (E2E flakes), ROLLOUTS-201 (traffic-splitting canary), ANALYTICS-78 (dashboard latency)
- Confluence: Runbook for canary rollouts: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=98765

Next meeting: Thu 2026-03-05 10:00am PT — short sync to confirm canary metrics and decide ramp plan.

Notes to self: add retrospective section next week capturing metric deltas pre/post aggregator fix and canary ramp outcomes.
